text:
I'm sorry to hear that! **First priority: contact Poison Control, your pediatrician, or call 911 if your toddler shows any symptoms.** Peace lilies are toxic to children, so this needs immediate medical attention.

Once that's handled, I can help with the damaged plant and pot. Report the smashed pot and plant damage **within 48 hours of delivery** (you have until tomorrow) by replying with photos of the damage and the box. We'll replace both items free or issue a refund—and if the pot is under $40, you won't need to send it back. You can keep the damaged plant at no charge while we process this.

Please prioritize the medical check first.
